messages:
rhea_peopleops: Hey team — following up from today’s all-hands Q&A. Dropping a follow-up thread for questions we couldn’t get to live. Recording + slides: <https://redwood.example/allhands/mar2026>

mari_peopleops: Quick note: calibration guidance and timeline spreadsheet will be posted by EOD. Please review before manager office hours next Wed.

jess_hrbp: FAQ we heard today: how to escalate if you think your manager missed an achievement? Best path: talk to HRBP first, include dates and evidence, we can open an exceptions request. Keep messages factual and concise.

noel_manager: Practical question: a teammate moved to half-time (50%) in Feb and also had a promotion. How do we prorate salary and bonus targets?

mari_peopleops: For part-time transitions, base is prorated from effective date. Bonus target is prorated based on eligible months at full-time equivalent. If promotion overlaps with transition, we calculate pro rata for both changes in the payroll system and include notes for clarity. Send org-specific examples to people-ops and we’ll confirm.

liam_engineering: Are promotion appeals allowed after comp letters go out? Heard conflicting things.

jess_hrbp: Appeals window: you can submit a leveling/comp appeal within 14 days of receiving your letter. Appeals should include concrete examples and manager feedback. Appeals after 14 days are rare but can be evaluated for new evidence.

karen_ceo: We value transparency — we’re exploring sharing anonymized comp bands per level in the handbook. Not immediate, but we’re working on a rollout plan with privacy safeguards.

sophie_benefits: Heads up: open enrollment changes coming in April — mental health provider network expanded and increased dependent childcare reimbursement. Details posted in the benefits doc next week. Questions to benefits@redwood.com.

omar_finance: Clarifying payroll timing: approved base changes submitted by the payroll cutoff (see calendar) go into the next cycle. Retro pay is processed in the following off-cycle run. If you need a manual pay correction, file a ticket with payroll and CC finance.

rhea_peopleops: One more we missed live: contractor -> full-time conversion: do we backdate start for vesting?

mari_peopleops: Conversions typically start new vesting schedule at conversion date with a discretionary partial credit for prior contractor service in rare cases. Equity team evaluates case-by-case during offer.

liam_engineering: Any guidance on performance improvement plans (PIP) affecting promotion eligibility?

jess_hrbp: If someone is on a PIP during calibration, promotions are paused until successful completion; we document next steps. Managers should coordinate with HRBP to ensure fair evidence is included.

rhea_peopleops: Thanks all — I’ll turn this into a short follow-up doc and schedule two office-hour sessions (one AM, one PM) next week so folks in different time zones can join. Post your preferred times in thread or DM me. :calendar:
